description: The bar chart illustrates execution accuracy results for two text-to-SQL methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across different query difficulty categories and an overall total. The category axis is horizontal and lists four groups in left-to-right order: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total; within each group there are two adjacent bars. The value axis is vertical, labeled “Execution Accuracy,” and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks spanning roughly from 20 up to around 70 (ticks appear at regular intervals of about 10). A legend indicates NatSQL as a light blue bar and TA-SQL as a darker blue bar. For Simple, the NatSQL bar is labeled 60.21 and the TA-SQL bar is labeled 63.14; for Moderate, NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60; for Challenging, NatSQL is 32.32 and TA-SQL is 36.11; and for Total, NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The bars are grouped side-by-side (not stacked), with numeric value annotations placed above each bar, and there is no visual indication that the categories are sorted by bar height beyond the fixed difficulty-to-total ordering.
